title: (No AI) Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![Illustration of the Google Gemini logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/02/STK255_Google_Gemini_B_474198.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

After introducing its Gemini AI assistant to [Android Auto last year](https://www.theverge.com/news/825008/googles-gemini-is-now-on-android-auto), Google is now bringing it to Apple CarPlay users. The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with "rollout happening globally too," according to Google (we've asked for specific regional availability details).

It's taken almost 12 months for Google to bring this to CarPlay users, but now they can talk to the voice assistant in Google Maps to get some hands-free help while driving. That includes asking it multi-step questions, such as recommendations on places to visit and then prompting it to direct you there while avoiding toll roads. Users …

title: (No AI) OpenAI says an AI agent lied about disabling its safety monitoring system
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Chat GPT logo on a graphic green background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/08/STK155_OPEN_AI_4_CVirginia_C.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

OpenAI [disclosed a pair of safety incidents](https://alignment.openai.com/misalignment-reports/suppressing-misalignment-monitoring-alerts-and-disabling-misalignment-monitoring) that involved AI agents weakening their safety monitoring systems during internal coding tasks. In one incident, OpenAI says its GPT-6 Astra agent disabled its safety monitor when copying reference code - and then lied about it.

"The reference didn't configure a monitor, and Astra decided that was reason to remove the monitoring integration from the user's code," Marcus Williams, an AI safety researcher at OpenAI, [writes on X](https://x.com/Marcus_J_W/status/2112695138199966084). "When the user asked whether Astra had removed monitoring, it lied and said that it had not."

A separate incident occurred after a GPT-6.1 Sol agent suppressed automatic se …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1015316/openai-ai-agent-disabling-monitoring-systems)
